package.layout_and_purpose: 9:16 (1080x1920), single Creatomate render, three fixed narrative beats in one flat elements[] array (time-offset, not nested compositions) — the same technique buildKineticTextSpec/buildStatRevealSpec already prove live. Scene 1 HOOK (pattern-interrupt headline, modeled verbatim on buildKineticTextSpec's hook scene, index.ts:1257-1261): grabs attention in the first ~6s. Scene 2 PROOF (stat/value reveal + supporting context, modeled verbatim on buildStatRevealSpec's stat-card scene, index.ts:1319-1327): the payload — this is the longest scene by design, carrying the credibility content. Scene 3 CTA (engagement question + follow prompt, modeled verbatim on buildKineticTextSpec's cta scene, index.ts:1262-1267): closes with a visual '?' watermark + headline + footer. This is a deliberate COMPOSITE of two already-proven-live scene shapes, not a novel animation mechanism — the multi-scene novelty is the FIXED 3-beat narrative shape and duration budget, not the per-scene visual grammar.
package.scene_layer_structure: Track/layer order (ascending, later = on top, mirrors both proven builders' implicit ordering by array position since neither builder sets explicit `track`): 1 BarTop, 2 BarBottom, 3 Logo (persistent chrome, all `time`-less/full-duration) → 4 Scene1Headline, 5 Scene1Subtitle (Scene 1, t=0-6) → 6 Scene2Circle (decorative, behind text), 7 Scene2StatValue, 8 Scene2Rule, 9 Scene2StatLabel, 10 Scene2ContextLine (Scene 2, t=6-32) → 11 Scene3Watermark (decorative, behind text), 12 Scene3Headline, 13 Scene3Footer (Scene 3, t=32-38). No nested Creatomate 'Composition' elements — this is ONE flat elements[] array with per-element absolute time/duration offsets, exactly the mechanism buildKineticTextSpec/buildStatRevealSpec already use in live production (index.ts:1219-1334), and exactly fork (a) named (and left open) by `m13-governed-template-build-pack-scoping-packet-v1.md:249-279`. This package resolves that fork as (a) because the mission's own evidence directive specified 'a complete POST-ready /v2/renders-shaped body... consistent with how this repo's proven single-scene templates are structured' — a single richer-elements render, not N-stitched sub-renders. Per that packet's own §7: 'If (a), M6 needs no multi-object Blueprint/Capture support at all — a single Variant with a richer elements[]... is sufficient, and M13's v1 scalar schema already covers it with no extension' — so this design requires no M13 schema extension and leaves the dormant sub_sequence_key seam (m13-blueprint-capture-schema-v1.md §1.1) untouched.

expected_visual_description: 0-6s (Scene 1, Hook): brand-colour full-bleed background, thin gold accent bars top/bottom, small logo top-left. A bold white pattern-interrupt headline fades in center-lower-middle of frame (e.g. '3-BEDROOM HOMES ARE VANISHING'), with a small '↓ Keep watching' cue beneath it. 6-32s (Scene 2, Proof): a faint decorative circle scales in behind a huge white stat number that bounces into view center-frame (e.g. '34.2%'), followed by a gold underline wipe, an all-caps gold stat label sliding up beneath it, and a supporting context sentence fading in below that — all elements hold on screen (this is the long, 'sit with the proof' beat) before fading out together just before Scene 3 starts. 32-38s (Scene 3, CTA): a huge faint '?' watermark appears behind a white engagement-question headline (e.g. 'Ready to see what your suburb is doing?'), with a gold 'Follow {Client} for more' footer fading in beneath it to close the video. Silent throughout (no voiceover/music in this v1 design).
platform_aspect_suitability: 9:16 / 1080x1920 — the SAME aspect/resolution as every currently-governed video template (video_short_stat, video_short_kinetic). Primary cited precedent for platform fit is YouTube Shorts (video_short_kinetic's proven 2026-08-01 production graduation was PP-YouTube-specific). Instagram Reels / TikTok / Facebook Reels are plausible SAME-aspect extensions but NOT independently evidenced here — platform_scope enforcement (M4) is itself flagged as still-open/'decorative until fixed' in the delta audit, so any platform beyond the one M6 is actually built+proven against should be treated as to_be_confirmed.

cheap_by_construction_reasons: Single Creatomate render call — no per-scene round trips; identical submit+poll mechanism to every proven video template.
13 total elements (3 persistent chrome + 10 scene elements) — well under kinetic's design, because M6's fixed-3-scene shape needs no off-timeline collapse logic.
Same 1080x1920/30fps mp4 output profile as every proven governed video template.
No background image asset / Ken-Burns motion-scale animation — solid brand-colour chrome only, deliberately, to keep per-frame render complexity low across a longer total duration.
